content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to develop an API in Python that can communicate with 24 PLCs, allowing each user to request access? If access is granted, the user would be able to upload their LAD file created in [product_name] from their PC remotely, even if the PC is not directly connected to the PLC. Currently, after searching online, I haven't found a way to upload a LAD file created in [product_name] using a custom API.
From what I understand, program transfer is only supported through [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking solutions for remote, API-based LAD file uploads to multiple [company_name] PLCs, aiming for network-enabled programming without physical connections. The lack of support for this workflow—outside the official [product_name] software—limits automation options and flexibility, leading to some confusion and unmet needs regarding bypassing the standard upload process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate functionality to upload LAD files to [company_name] PLCs via a custom network API, eliminating the need for physical connections or exclusive dependence on the official [product_name] software.
pain_keywords: lack of API support for upload
